besluite.rede: The previous sentence ends on 'daarna', which moves time past the prison, so 'Daar' straight after it makes a Grade 4 reader look back past that clause to find the place and echoes 'daarna'; the original's explicit 'in die tronk' is clearer, so this is not clearly better.
